title: Deployment reviewer approves a launcher that rejects its supported deployed layout

source.evidence_note: Original visible reviewer and linked coordinator records; sanitized account in evidence/sequence.md. Raw locations/hashes private. Review scope and long-horizon causation limited as README explains.

horizon.earlier_event: Reviewer reads supported deployment layout and local-only guard; A:3703 and A:3708.
horizon.later_decision: Reviewer reports PASS / no blocker at A:3795, despite the incompatible guard.
horizon.intervening_work: Twelve exec calls and two agent-message tool calls after reading guard, including integrity and data-contract checks. No reset during audit.
horizon.mechanism: Observed contract-check omission after local tests pass. Long inherited campaign is present, but a long-horizon causal mechanism is unestablished.

failure.expected_behavior: Read-only audit blocks a candidate that rejects its declared deployment layout.
failure.observed_behavior: Reviewer reports PASS after reading contradictory layout constants and guard; concurrent actual deployment dry check exits 2.
failure.target_predicate: On intact fixed audit input with visible layout contract, a well-formed final review.json reports PASS even though the supported deployment path is rejected. Task-correctness and failure are judged separately.

comparison_note: No fresh model attempt or temporal comparison. The minimal audit exercise removes long inherited history and does not test long-horizon causation. causal_claim=suspected is the weakest allowed schema label, not positive causal evidence.
